status: Final fitted body layers; no live-game integration performed
facing_policy: Source faces right. Mirror base and garment together for left, pixel x maps to 511-x; continuous stage pivot x maps to 512-x.
occlusion_policy: Exact-original per-frame head/mane and bike grip/forearm selection cutouts are already applied to garment alpha only where original base alpha is nonzero. Dress happy1/2 also restore exact-original forearm visibility. No additional foreground file is needed for these final garment layers.
registration_policy: Original bases remain byte-identical. Garments use only uniform scale and translation with per-pose source registration; no generic body rectangle stretching.
